title: Fed decision in April?
description:
The FED interest rates are defined in this market by the upper bound of the target federal funds range. The decisions on the target federal fund range are made by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings.

This market will resolve to the amount of basis points the upper bound of the target federal funds rate is changed by versus the level it was prior to the Federal Reserve's April 2026 meeting.

If the target federal funds rate is changed to a level not expressed in the displayed options, the change will be rounded up to the nearest 25 and will resolve to the relevant bracket. (e.g. if there's a cut/increase of 12.5 bps it will be considered to be 25 bps)

The resolution source for this market is the FOMC’s statement after its meeting scheduled for April 28-29, 2026 according to the official calendar: https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm.

The level and change of the target federal funds rate is also published at the official website of the Federal Reserve at https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/openmarket.htm.

This market may resolve as soon as the FOMC’s statement for their April meeting with relevant data is issued. If no statement is released by the end date of the next scheduled meeting, this market will resolve to the "No change" bracket.

title: US x Iran ceasefire extended by...?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if there is an official extension of the two-week ceasefire agreement between the United States and Iran announced on April 7, 2026, defined as a publicly announced and mutually agreed extension to the halt in direct military engagement between the United States and Iran, by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Both extensions of the April 7 ceasefire and new agreements scheduled to take effect before or at the initial agreement's scheduled end will be considered extensions of the ceasefire agreement, provided there is no period during which no ceasefire is in effect.

If a qualifying agreement is officially reached before the resolution date, this market will resolve to “Yes,” regardless of whether the ceasefire extension ultimately takes effect. 

An extension of the ceasefire agreement requires clear public confirmation from both the United States government and the government of Iran that they have agreed to halt military hostilities against one another for longer than the initially agreed two-week period, or for an official extension of the ceasefire agreement in place to be otherwise confirmed by an overwhelming consensus of media reporting.

Any form of informal understanding, backchannel communication, de-escalation, or unilateral pause in hostilities without a confirmed agreement on a qualifying extension will not qualify. Similarly, newly agreed-upon humanitarian pauses, limited operational pauses, or temporary tactical stand-downs will not qualify.

A newly agreed-upon broader peace deal will qualify if it includes a qualifying extension of the ceasefire agreement/halt in military hostilities. Agreements that outline future negotiations or de-escalation measures, but do not explicitly commit to extending the ceasefire, will not qualify.

This market’s resolution will be based on official statements from the United States government and the government of Iran. However, an overwhelming consensus of credible media reporting confirming that an official ceasefire extension agreement has been reached will suffice.

title: Trump Today: April 25
description: This is a market over what Donald Trump will do on April 25, 2026.

markets.question: Will Trump dance today?
markets.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Donald Trump dances between 12:00AM ET and 11:59PM ET on April 25, 2026. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

"Dancing" is defined as deliberate, rhythmic body movement typically matched music or a beat, such as swaying, stepping, or coordinated hand or body motions. Casual gesturing, clapping, or incidental body movement will not qualify. Dancing without the presence of music or a beat will qualify.

AI-generated content, deepfakes, or altered footage will not be considered. 

Videos posted on his social media which were filmed outside this market's time frame will not qualify for a "Yes" resolution.

This market will resolve based on video.

markets.question: Will Trump wear a red tie today?
markets.description:

The color will be determined by the most visually dominant color visible in publicly available photos or videos. For example, for the tie to be considered predominantly blue, its primary color must be a shade of blue, though it may feature other colors as part of a pattern. This tie would count as "Blue": https://i.ytimg.com/vi/20w7J2JAmqw/maxresdefault.jpg

The following tie has no distinguishable predominant color, and thus would resolve to "No". https://www.usatoday.com/gcdn/authoring/authoring-images/2025/01/20/USAT/77837111007-xxx-dcmg-105-5190802.jpg

If Donald Trump does not wear a tie or if no photos or video are released from the listed date, this market will resolve to "No".

The resolution source will be a consensus of credible reporting.

The resolution source will be a consensus of credible reporting.

markets.question: Will Trump sign an executive order today?
markets.description:
This market will resolve "Yes" if Donald Trump signs an executive order on April 25, 2026. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Executive actions will not qualify toward this market’s resolution.

This market will immediately resolve "Yes" if the text of an executive order for the given day is published on the White House page for presidential actions (https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/) or the White House press pool. Mere announcements will not qualify.

If no executive order is published by 12:00 PM ET the day after the listed date of this market, this market will resolve to “No”.

In the case of ambiguity this market may remain open until it is confirmed by the federal register.

markets.question: Will Trump say "Sleepy Joe" today?
markets.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Donald Trump says the listed term on April 25, 2026. Otherwise, the market will resolve to "No".

Plural and possessive forms of the listed term will count toward the resolution of this market regardless of context; however, other forms will NOT count.

Instances where the term is used in a compound word will count regardless of context (e.g., joyful is not a compound word for "joy," however, "killjoy" is a compounding of the words "kill" and "joy").

If this market requires a specified number of mentions of a person’s first or last name, a full-name mention will count as one mention (e.g., if a market is about “Joe / Biden 5+ times,” a mention of “Joe Biden” will count once).

A ‘mention’ will include any verbal mention which is recorded (audio or video) and publicly accessible.

Written usages of terms (e.g. Truth Social posts, written statements, etc.) will not count toward this market's resolution.

AI-generated audio or video will not count toward this market's resolution.

Videos posted on his social media which were filmed outside this market's time frame will not qualify for a "Yes" resolution.

eventMetadata.context_description: President Trump's morning press gaggle in Palm Beach on April 25 featured disputed video footage showing deliberate rhythmic body movements that traders widely interpret as qualifying "dancing" under market rules, driving near-100% consensus for "Yes" amid $5.4 million in volume. The clip, captured before his travel to Washington, sparked debate over authenticity and casual gesturing exclusions, with the market now pending UMA oracle review. A separate shooting incident at the White House Correspondents' Association Dinner later that evening—where suspect Cole Tomas Allen was subdued by Secret Service agents near security screening, wounding one—prompted swift evacuation of Trump, Melania Trump, and officials like JD Vance, halting proceedings and resolving a related dance market "No." No executive orders were signed that day; Allen's detention hearing is scheduled for April 30.

title: Israel x Hezbollah Ceasefire extended by...?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if there is an official extension of the 10-day ceasefire agreement between Israel and Hezbollah announced on April 16, 2026, defined as a publicly announced and mutually agreed extension to the halt in direct military engagement between Israel and Hezbollah, by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Both extensions of the April 16 ceasefire and new agreements scheduled to take effect before or at the initial agreement's scheduled end will be considered extensions of the ceasefire agreement, provided there is no period during which no ceasefire is in effect.

If a qualifying agreement is officially reached before the resolution date, this market will resolve to “Yes,” regardless of whether the ceasefire extension ultimately takes effect.

An extension of the ceasefire agreement requires clear public confirmation from both the Israeli government and Hezbollah that they have agreed to halt military hostilities against one another for longer than the initially agreed 10-day period, or for an official extension of the ceasefire agreement in place to be otherwise confirmed by an overwhelming consensus of media reporting.

Any form of informal understanding, backchannel communication, de-escalation, or unilateral pause in hostilities without a confirmed agreement on a qualifying extension will not qualify. Similarly, newly agreed-upon humanitarian pauses, limited operational pauses, or temporary tactical stand-downs will not qualify.

A newly agreed-upon broader peace deal will qualify if it includes a qualifying extension of the ceasefire agreement/halt in military hostilities. Agreements that outline future negotiations or de-escalation measures, but do not explicitly commit to extending the ceasefire, will not qualify.

This market’s resolution will be based on official statements from the Israeli government and Hezbollah. However, an overwhelming consensus of credible media reporting confirming that an official ceasefire extension agreement has been reached will suffice.

eventMetadata.context_description: **President Trump's Operation Epic Fury against Iran, launched February 28, 2026, with joint US-Israeli airstrikes on nuclear facilities, military bases, and leadership targets including Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei, persists without a formal end announcement despite a ceasefire holding since early April.** The administration claims decisive successes, such as obliterating Iran's navy, ballistic missiles, and air defenses, enabling Hormuz Strait reopening, but maintains a naval blockade and conducted strikes on mine-laying vessels April 23 amid failed Pakistan-mediated talks. Ongoing tensions over Hormuz shipping, cyber operations, and proxy threats sustain military posture, with traders eyeing revised Iranian proposals, congressional oversight, and economic pressures from oil disruptions as potential catalysts for de-escalation signals before key deadlines.

eventMetadata.context_description: California Gov. Gavin Newsom commands trader consensus at 27% implied probability for the 2028 Democratic presidential nomination, driven by his executive record, robust national fundraising, and early positioning as a Trump administration critic via book tours in New Hampshire and a March California primary poll lead over Kamala Harris. Recent April events, including Rev. Al Sharpton's National Action Network convention where Harris drew the strongest Black voter applause and a Michigan gathering featuring Harris alongside Cory Booker and Andy Beshear, highlighted the wide-open primary field. Sen. Jon Ossoff surged to third after his April 18 "Mar-a-Lago mafia" speech slamming foreign policy; Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez holds second via progressive base appeal. Diverging from polls like McLaughlin's favoring Harris, consolidation awaits 2026 midterm results, endorsements, and swing-state polling.

eventMetadata.context_description: HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. leads trader consensus at 49% implied probability for the 2028 Republican presidential nomination, driven by his rapid MAHA agenda achievements over the past 14 months—including new dietary guidelines prioritizing real food, 40% industry pledges to remove toxic synthetic dyes, SNAP reforms in 37 states, CDC vaccine schedule updates, and HHS restructuring cutting bloat while targeting Medicare fraud—which have built a broad health-focused coalition beyond traditional GOP voters. Vice President J.D. Vance holds 39% as the perceived heir apparent in Trump's second term, though his lead has narrowed amid administration challenges. Secretary of State Marco Rubio's 22% reflects a recent CPAC straw poll surge to 35% on Trump insider endorsements, positioning the early field amid Trump's term limits and pre-midterm jockeying.

title: Paris Saint-Germain FC vs. FC Bayern München - More Markets
description: More markets for the UEFA Champions League game, scheduled for April 28 at 3:00 PM ET.

markets.question: Spread: Paris Saint-Germain FC (-1.5)
markets.description:
In the upcoming UEFA Champions League game, scheduled for April 28 at 3:00 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Paris Saint-Germain FC" if Paris Saint-Germain FC win the game by 2 or more goals.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "FC Bayern München".

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50–50.

This market will resolve according to the official final score published on uefa.com. This market refers only to the outcome within the first 90 minutes of regular play plus stoppage time.

The primary resolution source for this market is the official statistics of the event as recognized by the governing body or event organizers. However, if the governing body or event organizers have not published final match statistics within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead.

title: US x Iran permanent peace deal by...?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if Iran and the United states agree to a permanent peace deal by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”. 

A permanent peace deal refers to any agreement which explicitly indicates that military hostilities between the United States and Iran have ended or will permanently cease, or uses equivalent language clearly signaling a lasting end to military hostilities between the United States and Iran. Agreements that are explicitly temporary or which do not include a definitive agreement to end military hostilities between the US and Iran on a lasting basis (e.g. a temporary extension of the two-week ceasefire agreement announced on April 7, 2026), will not qualify.

A qualifying agreement will be considered to have been established if either of the following conditions are met:

- The United States and Iran each sign or formally adopt a written agreement (e.g. a treaty or multi-point agreement) which meets the above criteria.

- Both the governments of the United States and Iran provide clear public confirmation that a qualifying agreement has been definitively established. Negotiations, statements of progress, or other statements which do not constitute a definitive announcement that a qualifying agreement has been reached will not count.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the governments of the United States and Iran; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

title: Will the Iranian regime fall by May 31?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the Islamic Republic of Iran’s current ruling regime is overthrown, collapsed, or otherwise ceases to govern by May 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

This requires a broad consensus of reporting indicating that core structures of the Islamic Republic (e.g. the office of the Supreme Leader, the Guardian Council, IRGC control under clerical authority) have been dissolved, incapacitated, or replaced by a fundamentally different governing system or otherwise lost de facto power over a majority of the population of Iran. This could occur via revolution, civil war, military coup, or voluntary abdication, but only qualifies if the Islamic Republic no longer exercises sovereign power.

Routine political events such as elections, reforms, or leadership succession do not qualify. Internal coups or power shifts that preserve the Islamic Republic’s core structures also do not qualify. Only a clear break in continuity—such as a new provisional government, revolutionary council, or constitution replacing the Islamic Republic will qualify.

Partial loss of territory or challenges from rebel or exile groups will not qualify unless the Islamic Republic no longer administers the majority of the Iranian population within Iran. 

The resolution source will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: President Trump's nominee Kevin Warsh holds commanding trader consensus at 98.7% implied probability for confirmation as Federal Reserve Chair, driven by his April 21 Senate Banking Committee hearing where he pledged monetary policy independence and a hawkish stance on inflation, easing concerns over White House influence. The Department of Justice ended its probe into Jerome Powell on April 24, clearing a major procedural block, while a key senator lifted a hold on April 27, paving the way for the committee's advancement vote on April 29 ahead of Powell's May 15 term end. GOP Senate majority supports passage, though Democrats cite Warsh's extensive financial disclosures—including over $100 million in assets and crypto holdings—as potential conflicts. Realistic challenges include committee rejection, new Epstein-related revelations, or holds delaying full Senate confirmation.

eventMetadata.context_description: In the Eastern Conference first-round playoffs, the Boston Celtics hold a commanding 3-1 series lead over the Philadelphia 76ers heading into Game 5 tonight at TD Garden, where Boston can clinch advancement with a victory. The Celtics dominated Game 4 on the road 128-96, fueled by Payton Pritchard's playoff career-high 32 points off the bench, showcasing their depth and defensive intensity that held Philly to 96 points. Joel Embiid, sidelined since early April due to appendectomy recovery, is now officially available per the latest injury report, potentially boosting the 76ers' frontcourt but raising rust concerns after a month away. Boston's full-strength lineup features Jayson Tatum, Jaylen Brown, and Neemias Queta at center, leveraging home-court advantage and momentum against a desperate Philadelphia squad facing elimination.

title: F1 Drivers' Champion
description:
This market will resolve according to the listed driver that finishes 1st in the driver standings for the 2026 F1 season.

This market will resolve as soon as the official results of the final scheduled race of the 2026 F1 season are known.

If multiple drivers tie for first place in the drivers standings, this market will resolve according to the tiebreak procedure used by F1 to determine the 2026 F1 Drivers’ champion.

eventMetadata.context_description: Mercedes' commanding early 2026 F1 season form has propelled George Russell and Kimi Antonelli to the top of trader consensus for the Drivers' Championship, with Russell's 41.5% implied probability edging Antonelli's 32.6% on his greater experience despite the rookie's nine-point standings lead (72-63). Antonelli's back-to-back wins in China and Japan, plus a close P2 behind Russell's Australian GP victory, underscore the Woking team's pace advantage under new regulations, while Ferrari's Charles Leclerc (49 points) trails. Recent intra-team harmony comments from both drivers ahead of Miami GP highlight a tight title fight, but Russell's consistency and qualifying edge temper enthusiasm for Antonelli's surprise surge amid a long season.

title: Eurovision Winner 2026

eventMetadata.context_description: Finland's "Liekinheitin" by violinist Linda Lampenius and pop star Pete Parkkonen remains the clear frontrunner at 35% implied probability on Polymarket, dominating betting markets, fan polls like OGAE, and preview rankings since their UMK national final victory in late February, thanks to its genre-blending appeal poised for strong jury and televote scores. Denmark's Søren Torpegaard Lund with "Før vi går hjem" has climbed to 13% following DMGP success and pre-party momentum, while Greece's Akylas ("Ferto") surges on massive YouTube streams to 11%, edging France's Monroe ("Regarde!") and Australia. Israel's entry gains as a televote dark horse amid boycott controversies. With first rehearsals underway this week ahead of Vienna semis on May 12/14, traders eye performance footage for momentum shifts in this unpredictable contest.

eventMetadata.context_description: Vice President JD Vance holds a slim edge as trader consensus favorite to win the 2028 presidential election, reflecting his status as the Republican heir apparent under President Trump and leading 39% odds in GOP nominee markets, while California Governor Gavin Newsom trails closely at 18% implied probability amid his top spot in Democratic primary betting at 26%. Recent UMass Lowell polling from late March showed Vance edging Newsom 33%-30% in a head-to-head matchup, but the fragmented field—including Senator Marco Rubio's rising 11%—keeps the race tightly contested this early in the cycle. The 2026 midterms loom as a key catalyst, with control of Congress and battleground state performances poised to build momentum, clarify paths to nomination, and potentially widen gaps through endorsements, turnout trends, or scandals.

title: What will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit in April 2026?
description: What will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit in April 2026?

markets.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $160 in April?
markets.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if, at any point during April 2026, any 1-minute candle for the Active Month of WTI Crude Oil futures has a final "High" price equal to or above the listed price. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

For WTI futures, the active month refers to the nearest listed contract month. The active month changes at 6:00:00 PM ET at the start of the trading session two business days prior to that contract's last trading day, at which point the next listed contract becomes the active month.

For WTI Crude Oil (CL) futures, the last trading day is defined as three business days prior to the 25th calendar day of the month preceding the contract's delivery month (or four business days prior if the 25th calendar day is not a business day), consistent with CME contract specifications.

Only prices achieved during the applicable trading session for the underlying market will be considered. Under the standard schedule, trading is open from 6:00:00 PM ET Sunday through 5:00:00 PM ET Friday, with a daily break from 5:00:00 PM ET to 6:00:00 PM ET, except where modified by holiday or special-session hours as listed on Pyth.

Prices will be used exactly as published by Pyth, without rounding.

If the Active Month contract does not trade at all during the listed time frame, this market will resolve to "No".

In the event of a contract specification change, feed change, or similar structural modification affecting the underlying market during the listed time frame, this market will resolve based on adjusted prices as displayed on Pyth.

eventMetadata.context_description: WTI crude oil futures for April 2026 settlement traded around $97 per barrel as of April 28, reflecting a trader consensus premium for persistent Middle East supply risks amid stalled US-Iran peace talks and Strait of Hormuz disruptions that have driven prices up from mid-April lows near $83. Recent EIA data showed US crude inventories rising 1.925 million barrels for the week ending April 17—counter to drawdown expectations—easing some pressure, while OPEC+ opted for a modest 206,000 barrels per day output hike starting May amid cautious recovery signals. Elevated Treasury yields and a firm US dollar cap upside, but upcoming EIA inventory report on April 29 and potential negotiation breakthroughs could sway near-term volatility, with backwardation in the futures curve signaling tight prompt supply.

eventMetadata.context_description: The New York Knicks host the Atlanta Hawks in Game 5 of their tightly contested NBA first-round playoff series, currently tied 2-2, with Madison Square Garden providing a raucous home-court advantage amid high-stakes elimination pressure. Recent games have been nail-biters—Knicks won Game 1 (113-102), Hawks edged Games 2 (107-106) and 3 (109-108), before Knicks evened it in Game 4—highlighting defensive intensity and late-game execution as pivotal. Hawks' backup center Jock Landale remains out with a right ankle sprain, taxing frontcourt depth behind Onyeka Okongwu, while Knicks enter healthy, led by Jalen Brunson and Karl-Anthony Towns' scoring prowess. Momentum favors the road-tested Hawks slightly, but Knicks' rest edge and crowd support could shift trader consensus on this do-or-die matchup.

eventMetadata.context_description: Daniil Medvedev holds a 2-0 head-to-head edge over Flavio Cobolli from prior hard-court meetings, but Madrid's high-altitude fast clay shifts dynamics in this ATP Masters 1000 round of 16 clash. Medvedev rebounded from a humiliating Monte-Carlo double bagel loss to Berrettini with his first 2026 clay wins here, grinding past Fabian Marozsan and teen qualifier Nicolai Budkov Kjaer to advance. Cobolli rides momentum from a comeback over Camilo Ugo Carabelli and a 6-3, 6-2 rout of Adolfo Daniel Vallejo, despite court complaints. No injury reports surface; Medvedev's baseline precision and return prowess give trader consensus a slight edge on the quicker surface, though Cobolli's clay grinding poses upset risk in potential three sets.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus prices Bayern Munich and PSG neck-and-neck at 32.5% implied probabilities to win the 2025/26 UEFA Champions League, reflecting the razor-thin margins in the freshly confirmed semi-final draw where they clash first on April 28/29 before second legs May 5/6, pitting two attack-heavy powerhouses with serial semi-final experience—Bayern's 12th since 2000, PSG's fifth as defending champions—against each other in a potential mutual knockout. Arsenal sits close at 25.5% thanks to their solid quarter-final progression past Sporting Lisbon, giving them a perceived edge in the contrasting defensive duel versus Atlético Madrid (11.3%), who dispatched Club Brugge earlier but face Arsenal's high press and home advantage in the second leg. Recent quarter-final drama, like Bayern's 4-3 aggregate thriller over Real Madrid two weeks ago, underscores the knockout volatility keeping this final-four race tightly bunched.

title: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by end of April?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if IMF Portwatch publishes a 7-day moving average of transit calls (“Arrivals of Ships”) for the Strait of Hormuz equal to or above 60 for any date between market creation and April 30, 2026. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

Daily transit calls include container, dry bulk, roll-on/roll-off, general cargo, and tanker ships. Ships not reported by IMF Portwatch will not be considered.

This market will resolve as soon as IMF Portwatch publishes a 7-day moving average of transit calls equal to or above the specified level, or once data has been published for the final date in the specified period and no such value has been published. If no data has been published for the final date of the specified period within 14 calendar days (ET) after the end of that period, this market will resolve based on data published up to that point.

Revisions to previously published data points made within this market’s timeframe will be considered. However, they will not disqualify a previously published data point from qualifying. Revisions to previously published data points after data is published for April 30, 2026, however, will not be considered.

The resolution source for this market will be IMF Portwatch, specifically the transit calls data published for the Strait of Hormuz at https://portwatch.imf.org/pages/cb5856222a5b4105adc6ee7e880a1730, both in the chart and through downloadable files.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket prices a 99.6% implied probability that Strait of Hormuz traffic will not return to normal by April 30, driven by persistent dual blockades amid the US-Iran conflict, with US naval restrictions on Iranian ports since mid-April and Iran's retaliatory closures slashing daily transits to under five vessels—versus pre-crisis averages exceeding 130—from real-time AIS data via MarineTraffic and IMF PortWatch. Recent April 27 Iranian overtures for reopening conditional on US blockade lift have gone unheeded, cementing sub-5% volume amid ship seizures and elevated war risk premiums deterring commercial flows. Tail risks include a last-minute diplomatic breakthrough or unilateral de-escalation before resolution, though proximity to deadline limits upside for normalization.

title: LoL: Fnatic vs Shifters (BO3) - Esports World Cup EMEA Qualifier Playoffs
description:
This market refers to the LoL Upper bracket round 1 match between Fnatic and Shifters in the Esports World Cup EMEA Qualifier Playoffs, initially scheduled for April 28 at 11:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to "Fnatic" if Fnatic win the match against Shifters.

This market will resolve to "Shifters" if Shifters win the match against Fnatic.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50. 

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to the team who wins. 

If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50. 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

In cases where a team’s listed name includes minor discrepancies from the resolution source, this market will resolve based on the underlying real-world match rather than exact name matching. Recognizable abbreviations, alternate or erroneous spellings, sponsor tags, affiliate or academy designations, regional identifiers, and minor formatting differences will be treated as referring to the same team, provided the intended team can be clearly and uniquely identified within the relevant competition. If a listed team name has no reasonable connection to any participating team, or if it matches or could reasonably refer to another team in the same competition such that the intended team cannot be unambiguously determined, this market will resolve 50-50.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if any player on either team achieves a Quadra Kill during Game 1. This market will resolve to "No" if no player achieves a Quadra Kill. A Penta Kill (5 kills in rapid succession) also counts as a Quadra Kill having occurred for the purposes of this market.

If the match is canceled (not played at all) or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 is never played due to forfeit, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 is not played because the series result has already been determined (e.g., a team clinches the series before Game 1 is needed), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If Game 1 begins but is not completed and ends via surrender, this market will resolve based on whether a Quadra Kill occurred prior to stoppage. If no Quadra Kill occurred, this market will resolve to "No".

If Game 1 is remade, resolution will be based on the remade game only.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

eventMetadata.context_description: Fnatic enters the Esports World Cup 2026 EMEA Qualifier playoffs upper bracket round 1 BO3 as the clear trader favorite against Shifters, bolstered by a decisive 2-0 sweep over them just four days ago in LEC Spring Week 5 Day 1, where Empyros and Razork dominated early skirmishes. Fnatic's LEC roster—Empyros (top), Razork (jungle), Vladi (mid), Upset (ADC), and Lospa (support)—brings superior macro execution and veteran poise amid mid-table form (around 2-3 recently), while Shifters, a tier-two EMEA Masters squad at 0-5 in LEC, struggles with consistency. No roster changes or injuries reported; the double-elimination bracket amplifies Fnatic's path to qualification, though Shifters' desperation could spark map-specific upsets under current patch dynamics.

title: LoL: Weibo Gaming vs Top Esports (BO3) - LPL Group Ascend
description:

eventMetadata.context_description: US-Iran diplomatic negotiations remain at an impasse following a fragile ceasefire after early 2026 military escalations, with no in-person bilateral talks occurring in the past 30 days despite multiple near-misses. On April 27, Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi blamed Washington for recent failures during a Moscow visit with President Putin, while US President Trump abruptly canceled planned Pakistan-mediated discussions three days prior, asserting American leverage. Sticking points include Iran's nuclear program, reopening the Strait of Hormuz, and Lebanon tensions. US officials are reviewing Tehran's latest Hormuz proposal, but no next-round date is confirmed, leaving trader consensus skeptical of imminent meetings amid heightened rhetoric and proxy pressures.
